name: humanize-ui
description: Give your coding agent design taste. Inspects the existing frontend, commits to a project-specific design direction, scouts curated human-designed component sources (Beautiful UI, beUI, Rare UI, Transitions.dev, shadcn/ui), evaluates fit and dependency cost, and adapts the best-fitting pieces into the app's own design language instead of pasting a theme over it. Ships a catalog of committed design briefs, concrete motion defaults, and an anti-slop audit run against a real render.

interface.shortDescription: Give your coding agent design taste — adapt proven human-designed components into your app's own language.
interface.longDescription: Use this skill when improving or building frontend UI where the result should feel more polished than a generic AI-generated interface. It inspects the existing frontend first, makes deliberate project-specific design choices second, scouts strong human-designed references third, then adapts the best-fitting pieces into the existing frontend foundation. Treats component libraries like LEGO, not like a theme to paste over the app. Ships a catalog of committed design briefs for when no brand direction exists, concrete motion defaults, and an anti-slop audit run against a real render.
defaultPrompt: Use humanize-ui on the pricing page. Keep the current brand, verify desktop and mobile.
